ValidationRule.description:
Sold Gross Margin is required Added requirement for Amount great than zero.
Case/Ticket: #00015044 #00016020
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Approve'), NOT(PRIORVALUE( StageName ) = 'Approve'), Amount > 0,
OR( ISNULL(Sold_Gross_Margin__c ), ISBLANK(Sold_Gross_Margin__c )),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Salesforce_Consulting'),
OR( ISPICKVAL( Type , 'New Business'), ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Existing Business')),
NOT(CONTAINS( Service_Offering_Rollup__c , 'Salesforce')), NOT(CONTAINS( Service_Offering_Rollup__c , 'HubSpot')), NOT(CONTAINS( Service_Offering_Rollup__c , 'Zingly')), NOT(CONTAINS( Service_Offering_Rollup__c , 'Application Solutions')),
NOT( $Permission.BypassValidationRules), NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This field is required before the Opportunity can be moved to "Approve" stage
